name: River Diversion Weirs
mechanism: Raise a controlled upstream water level to direct part of a river flow into an intake
operating_requirement: Actual channel works, stable foundations and maintained flow openings
consequence: Divert bounded flow while retaining upstream flooding and downstream flow consequences

name: Water Intake Screening
mechanism: Exclude specified debris and organisms from an intake with a maintainable physical screen
operating_requirement: Suitable openings, actual screen area, cleaning access and available intake head
consequence: Protect downstream works while retaining clogging, entrainment and head-loss constraints

name: Sediment Scour Outlets
mechanism: Remove accumulated sediment through a controlled low outlet or flushing path
operating_requirement: A suitable basin, working outlet and managed destination for sediment-laden water
consequence: Restore some storage or intake function at a water and disposal cost

name: Earthen Flood Embankments
mechanism: Construct and maintain a compacted barrier against a specified flood-water level
operating_requirement: Suitable soil, controlled placement, foundations, drainage and inspection labor
consequence: Reduce frequent inundation within a design envelope while retaining overtopping and breach risk

name: Puddled-Clay Water Linings
mechanism: Compact suitable wet clay into a low-permeability lining with protected continuity
operating_requirement: Actual suitable clay, prepared support, placement labor and crack prevention
consequence: Reduce seepage without assuming an indefinitely watertight boundary

name: Subsurface Field Drainage
mechanism: Collect excess soil water through buried permeable or jointed drainage paths
operating_requirement: Suitable outlets, installed drains and soil-specific spacing and maintenance
consequence: Lower waterlogging while transferring water and dissolved material downstream

name: Flood Spillway Design
mechanism: Provide a controlled overflow path sized against uncertain inflows and erosion limits
operating_requirement: Actual bypass capacity, stable construction and maintained outlet
consequence: Reduce uncontrolled overtopping without guaranteeing protection from every flood

name: Hydraulic Jump Dissipation
mechanism: Use a controlled transition from fast shallow flow to slower deeper flow to dissipate energy
operating_requirement: Qualified channel geometry, tailwater and erosion-resistant structure
consequence: Limit downstream scour within a measured operating range

name: Water Hammer Models
mechanism: Model pressure waves caused by rapid changes in conduit flow
operating_requirement: Pipe elasticity, fluid properties, valve timing and transient observations
consequence: Identify pressure excursions beyond steady-flow estimates

name: Pressure-Reducing Water Valves
mechanism: Throttle a water path in response to downstream pressure to maintain a bounded pressure setting
operating_requirement: Working valve, suitable pressure differential and maintenance access
consequence: Control local pressure while dissipating hydraulic energy

name: Pipeline Air Management
mechanism: Release accumulated gas and admit air where needed to avoid harmful vacuum or trapped pockets
operating_requirement: Correctly located functional vents, pressure limits and inspection
consequence: Reduce gas-related flow interruption without treating vents as contamination-proof

name: Hydraulic Ram Pumps
mechanism: Use repeated flow interruption to lift a fraction of driving water to a higher head
operating_requirement: Sufficient flowing supply, drive pipe, working valves and a pressure chamber
consequence: Lift some water without an external motor while discharging the remaining flow

name: Bank-Filtration Intakes
mechanism: Draw source water through characterized bank sediments before collection
operating_requirement: Suitable aquifer connection, actual intake capacity and monitored travel and quality
consequence: Provide partial pretreatment while retaining breakthrough and source-depletion risks

name: Saltwater Intrusion Models
mechanism: Model movement of saline water in response to freshwater gradients and extraction
operating_requirement: Observed heads, salinity profiles and characterized aquifer boundaries
consequence: Constrain pumping or recharge choices without assuming a fixed fresh-salt interface

name: Aquifer Compaction Models
mechanism: Relate changing groundwater pressure to compressible-layer deformation and storage loss
operating_requirement: Pressure histories, deformable-layer properties and deformation observations
consequence: Expose potentially irreversible subsidence rather than counting all drawdown as recoverable storage

name: Groundwater Capture-Zone Models
mechanism: Estimate source areas and travel times supplying an abstraction point
operating_requirement: Qualified flow model, boundary conditions and measured or bounded properties
consequence: Guide source protection while exposing uncertain contamination travel paths

name: Catchment Water Balance
mechanism: Reconcile precipitation, evapotranspiration, storage change and exported flows over a defined catchment
operating_requirement: Comparable observations, a declared boundary and uncertainty estimates
consequence: Identify unsustainable withdrawals or missing fluxes without manufacturing recharge

name: Granular Carbon Adsorption
mechanism: Pass water through qualified porous carbon that binds selected dissolved compounds
operating_requirement: Actual suitable media, contact capacity and measured breakthrough
consequence: Remove specified compounds until media exhaustion while producing spent material

name: Water Ion Exchange
mechanism: Exchange selected dissolved ions with ions held on a qualified solid medium
operating_requirement: Suitable resin or mineral medium, regeneration or replacement supply and waste handling
consequence: Remove selected ions while producing a finite spent or regenerant stream

name: Electrodialytic Water Separation
mechanism: Drive ions through selective membranes using an electrical potential
operating_requirement: Qualified membranes, actual power, compatible feed and concentrate handling
consequence: Separate ionic species with feed-dependent energy and fouling limits

name: Water Nanofiltration
mechanism: Use a qualified pressure-driven membrane with selective dissolved-solute rejection
operating_requirement: Compatible membrane, pumping, characterized feed and reject management
consequence: Remove a specified solute fraction without assuming complete salt removal

name: Dissolved-Air Flotation
mechanism: Attach released fine gas bubbles to suitable particles and collect the floated layer
operating_requirement: Pressurized gas-water contact, separation area, energy and sludge removal
consequence: Separate buoyant aggregates poorly removed by ordinary settling

name: Water Aeration Contactors
mechanism: Exchange volatile constituents between flowing water and a controlled air stream
operating_requirement: Qualified contact geometry, air supply and managed off-gas
consequence: Remove or add selected gases while retaining contaminant-specific transfer limits

name: Precipitative Water Softening
mechanism: Convert selected dissolved hardness constituents into removable precipitates
operating_requirement: Qualified reagents, reaction control, separation and residuals handling
consequence: Reduce specified hardness while consuming chemicals and producing sludge

name: Water Distribution Corrosion Control
mechanism: Adjust compatible water chemistry and verify metal release under actual pipe conditions
operating_requirement: Characterized network materials, suitable treatment and continuing sampling
consequence: Reduce qualified corrosion or leaching without assuming all pipes respond equally

name: Disinfection Byproduct Assessment
mechanism: Measure and compare unwanted reaction products alongside achieved microbial treatment
operating_requirement: Suitable assays, representative samples and known treatment conditions
consequence: Expose treatment tradeoffs without replacing required disinfection with unchecked delivery

name: Filter Ripening Control
mechanism: Qualify filtrate after filter cleaning before returning a unit to normal service
operating_requirement: Actual monitoring, diversion capacity and qualified filter recovery criteria
consequence: Prevent startup breakthrough from being counted as fully treated output

name: Membrane Integrity Testing
mechanism: Check whether a membrane assembly retains its qualified barrier continuity
operating_requirement: Compatible challenge or physical integrity measurements and isolation capacity
consequence: Detect specified barrier failures without guaranteeing removal of untested constituents

name: Membrane Fouling Control
mechanism: Diagnose and limit deposits that alter membrane flow or separation performance
operating_requirement: Observed pressure and flux, compatible cleaning and finite replacement stock
consequence: Maintain bounded throughput while retaining cleaning downtime and membrane wear

name: Sewer Gas Ventilation
mechanism: Manage gas accumulation and exposure in confined wastewater infrastructure
operating_requirement: Qualified ventilation paths, monitoring and maintained equipment
consequence: Reduce specified exposure and pressure risks without making confined spaces automatically safe

name: Anaerobic Baffled Reactors
mechanism: Pass wastewater through retained anaerobic treatment zones to increase contact with active biomass
operating_requirement: Suitable temperature, feed, retention volume and controlled gas and solids handling
consequence: Treat a biodegradable load with finite capacity and residual contamination

name: Sequencing-Batch Wastewater Treatment
mechanism: Alternate filling, biological reaction, separation and withdrawal in a timed reactor cycle
operating_requirement: Actual tank capacity, controls, energy and sludge management
consequence: Perform sequential treatment in shared volume while retaining cycle and inflow constraints

name: Membrane Bioreactor Treatment
mechanism: Retain treatment biomass with a membrane while withdrawing qualified permeate
operating_requirement: Actual biological capacity, membrane area, energy, cleaning and residuals handling
consequence: Separate treated liquid from biomass without eliminating dissolved-contaminant treatment needs

name: Anammox Wastewater Treatment
mechanism: Use a qualified anaerobic microbial pathway to convert supplied nitrogen species to nitrogen gas
operating_requirement: Suitable feed chemistry, retained active biomass and monitored process conditions
consequence: Reduce a specified nitrogen load with startup and stability limits

name: Struvite Nutrient Recovery
mechanism: Recover a qualified phosphorus-bearing crystalline product from suitable wastewater streams
operating_requirement: Characterized feed, reaction control, product separation and contaminant testing
consequence: Recover some nutrients without claiming all residuals are usable fertilizer

name: Sludge Mechanical Dewatering
mechanism: Separate part of the liquid from sludge by qualified mechanical force
operating_requirement: Actual press or centrifuge, power, maintenance and liquid-return treatment
consequence: Reduce transport volume without equating dewatering with pathogen removal

name: Sludge Drying Beds
mechanism: Use drainage and evaporation to reduce water in a contained sludge layer
operating_requirement: Suitable climate, actual bed area and controlled drainage and removal
consequence: Reduce sludge moisture with weather-dependent time and residual contamination

name: Wastewater Residence Tracing
mechanism: Measure flow-path and residence-time distributions with a qualified tracer
operating_requirement: Compatible tracer, controlled observation and operating flow records
consequence: Find short-circuiting missed by nominal tank-volume estimates

name: Sewer Overflow Storage Control
mechanism: Retain and release wet-weather wastewater against actual sewer and treatment capacity
operating_requirement: Available storage, monitored inflow and maintained gates or pumps
consequence: Reduce some untreated overflow while preserving capacity exceedance and downstream load

name: Water-Quality Surrogate Validation
mechanism: Test whether a convenient measurement reliably bounds a specified water-quality property under declared conditions
operating_requirement: Paired reference assays, representative operating data and continuing checks
consequence: Use faster indicators within demonstrated limits without treating clarity as proof of safety

name: Species Interaction Networks
mechanism: Record and test who consumes, supports or competes with whom in an observed community
operating_requirement: Repeated observations, species identification and uncertainty records
consequence: Represent biological dependencies without assuming every interaction is known

name: Population Resource-Limit Models
mechanism: Relate abundance change to measured limiting resources and density effects
operating_requirement: Repeated population observations and actual resource measurements
consequence: Estimate context-dependent capacity without assigning a permanent universal carrying number

name: Metapopulation Connectivity Models
mechanism: Model local extinction and recolonization across connected habitat patches
operating_requirement: Patch observations, movement evidence and uncertain transition rates
consequence: Assess network persistence without treating a drawn corridor as successful dispersal

name: Disturbance Regime Models
mechanism: Compare ecological responses to event frequency, intensity, extent and recovery intervals
operating_requirement: Dated disturbance records and repeated biological observations
consequence: Distinguish recurring disturbance from a single isolated event

name: Ecological Succession Models
mechanism: Compare community change after disturbance while allowing several possible trajectories
operating_requirement: Repeated observations and characterized site conditions
consequence: Plan recovery without assuming every site follows one fixed climax sequence

name: Functional Trait Analysis
mechanism: Relate measured organism traits to ecological functions and responses
operating_requirement: Representative trait measurements and qualified comparison methods
consequence: Compare functional composition without treating species as interchangeable

name: Food-Web Energy Accounts
mechanism: Track measured energy transfer and losses between trophic compartments
operating_requirement: Production and consumption estimates with explicit boundaries
consequence: Bound supported biomass without double-counting the same energy at every trophic level

name: Ecological Toxicity Bioassays
mechanism: Compare qualified biological responses across controlled exposure and reference conditions
operating_requirement: Suitable test organisms, characterized exposure and responsible contained assessment
consequence: Identify organism- and condition-specific effects without a universal safe threshold

name: Biomagnification Models
mechanism: Model accumulation of persistent substances through measured dietary transfer and elimination
operating_requirement: Qualified exposure, tissue and food-web evidence
consequence: Identify possible trophic concentration without assuming every contaminant magnifies

name: Eutrophication Load Models
mechanism: Relate nutrient inputs, retention and biological response in a receiving waterbody
operating_requirement: Measured loads, residence conditions and observed ecological response
consequence: Compare load-reduction options without promising immediate recovery

name: Lake Stratification Models
mechanism: Model density layering and seasonal mixing under measured heat and inflow conditions
operating_requirement: Temperature and depth observations, weather and waterbody geometry
consequence: Identify isolated water layers without assuming uniform oxygen or temperature

name: Hypoxia Forecast Models
mechanism: Estimate oxygen supply and demand under changing mixing and biological activity
operating_requirement: Qualified oxygen observations, load estimates and weather or circulation information
consequence: Anticipate bounded low-oxygen risk without certainty about every event

name: Legacy Nutrient Release Models
mechanism: Estimate delayed nutrient release from stored soil or sediment pools
operating_requirement: Characterized stored material, measured release and transport conditions
consequence: Explain lagged recovery after present inputs fall without inventing new nutrient mass

name: Phenological Mismatch Analysis
mechanism: Compare timing changes among interacting species and their resource availability
operating_requirement: Repeated seasonal observations and identified interactions
consequence: Detect possible timing mismatches without assuming every shift reduces survival

name: Migratory Connectivity Tracking
mechanism: Link seasonal habitat use across actual individual or population movements
operating_requirement: Qualified tracking or identification evidence and repeated distant observations
consequence: Identify connected seasonal dependencies without revealing unobserved routes automatically

name: Deadwood Habitat Retention
mechanism: Retain measured decaying wood structures for organisms that depend on them
operating_requirement: Suitable retained material, site access and balanced fire or public-use constraints
consequence: Preserve specific microhabitats while retaining competing land-use effects

name: Herbivory Exclosure Trials
mechanism: Compare vegetation recovery with and without selected browsing access
operating_requirement: Actual maintained barriers, comparison plots and repeated observations
consequence: Separate some browsing effects from other limits without assuming fencing restores all vegetation

name: Wildlife Crossing Structures
mechanism: Provide and guide target animals through a qualified passage across a transport barrier
operating_requirement: Actual crossing structure, appropriate approaches and monitored animal use
consequence: Reduce a specified movement barrier without guaranteeing use by every species

name: Rangeland Residual-Forage Management
mechanism: Set and revise grazing pressure against measured remaining forage and recovery conditions
operating_requirement: Actual stock records, forage observations and enforceable access arrangements
consequence: Avoid some overuse while retaining drought and movement constraints

name: Wildlife Disease Contact Models
mechanism: Estimate disease-relevant contacts across wildlife populations and shared resources
operating_requirement: Qualified occurrence evidence, movement observations and biological interpretation
consequence: Assess possible transmission links without assuming observation proves infection

name: Seagrass Establishment Methods
mechanism: Establish qualified seagrass propagules where light, sediment and water conditions permit persistence
operating_requirement: Actual suitable propagules, prepared sites and sustained monitoring
consequence: Attempt habitat recovery with survival uncertainty and no automatic meadow creation

name: Kelp Grazing-Balance Management
mechanism: Manage observed grazer pressure and recruitment limits in a qualified kelp restoration site
operating_requirement: Actual ecological evidence, authorized interventions and monitored recruitment
consequence: Support conditional kelp recovery without assuming predator or grazer manipulation always works

name: Coral Recruitment Support
mechanism: Improve qualified larval settlement and early survival on assessed reef substrates
operating_requirement: Suitable local biological material, compatible substrate and monitored environmental conditions
consequence: Attempt measured reef recruitment without promising resistance to future heat or disease

name: Living Shoreline Integration
mechanism: Combine habitat establishment and limited structural support against a specified coastal wave and tide regime
operating_requirement: Suitable space, material, planting conditions and monitored coastal response
consequence: Reduce some erosion while retaining storm, migration-space and ecological limits

name: Seed-Bank Viability Assessment
mechanism: Estimate which viable propagules persist in a sampled soil or sediment reserve
operating_requirement: Representative samples, qualified germination or viability evidence and seasonal context
consequence: Distinguish present vegetation from possible regeneration sources

name: Ecological Before-After Controls
mechanism: Compare change at intervention and reference sites before and after treatment
operating_requirement: Comparable sites, repeated observations and an explicit confounding review
consequence: Strengthen attribution without claiming nonrandom sites prove all causality

name: Ecological Occupancy Dynamics
mechanism: Estimate patch colonization and disappearance separately from changing detection
operating_requirement: Repeated site observations, detection information and defined sampling periods
consequence: Track distribution turnover without equating every nondetection with extinction

name: Species Distribution Ensembles
mechanism: Compare several habitat-association models and expose disagreement under new conditions
operating_requirement: Qualified occurrence data, environmental coverage and independent evaluation
consequence: Bound suitability inference without guaranteeing establishment or migration

name: Extinction Debt Models
mechanism: Estimate delayed population loss after habitat change using persistence and recruitment evidence
operating_requirement: Longitudinal observations, habitat histories and uncertain demographic rates
consequence: Recognize that current presence may not establish long-term viability

name: Restoration Sequence Dependency
mechanism: Order interventions around limiting physical conditions and biological dependencies
operating_requirement: Actual site diagnosis, finite crews and measured response
consequence: Avoid planting before a necessary condition is restored without imposing one universal sequence

name: Ecosystem Early-Warning Models
mechanism: Evaluate candidate changes in variability or recovery behavior as possible warning signals
operating_requirement: Long enough observations, noise assessment and model comparison
consequence: Flag conditional risk while retaining false alarms and missed transitions

name: Bioacoustic Species Monitoring
mechanism: Infer qualified species activity from calibrated acoustic observations
operating_requirement: Actual recorders, power, reference calls and validation across background conditions
consequence: Extend some surveys while retaining silent species and classification errors

name: Restoration Genetic Diversity Design
mechanism: Choose source mixtures against observed diversity, local adaptation and mixing uncertainty
operating_requirement: Qualified biological evidence, available source stock and monitored outcomes
consequence: Reduce selected genetic bottlenecks without guaranteeing beneficial mixing

name: Assisted Gene-Flow Review
mechanism: Assess controlled movement of genetic variants among connected populations against adaptation and disruption risks
operating_requirement: Qualified population evidence, authorized source access and long-term monitoring
consequence: Evaluate a conditional adaptation option without promising climate-proof populations

name: Microbial Community Restoration Trials
mechanism: Compare qualified microbial-community interventions against natural recovery and reference conditions
operating_requirement: Characterized benign material, responsible trials and ecological measurements
consequence: Test context-specific community recovery without assuming a supplied inoculum establishes

name: Landscape Refugia Planning
mechanism: Identify accessible areas likely to retain suitable conditions through a specified disturbance or climate scenario
operating_requirement: Qualified local evidence, uncertain projections and actual habitat access
consequence: Prioritize conditional refuge protection without permanent safety guarantees

name: Seed Dispersal Models
mechanism: Infer propagule movement, deposition and establishment opportunities from measured dispersal and source evidence
operating_requirement: Identified sources, representative seed or propagule observations and qualified detection estimates
consequence: Estimate regeneration reach without treating nearby adult plants as guaranteed recruitment
